what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Nigeria, counted by IDMC and UNHCR side by side.
At the end of 2025, IDMC estimated 3495705 people living in internal displacement because of conflict and violence, and UNHCR counted 3544519.
Refugees from Nigeria live mainly in Niger and Cameroon.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Nigeria with JAS in 2009 and from 2011 to 2025, and armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2015 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict over Biafra territory with IPOB from 2021 to 2025.
Floods are among the disasters recorded for Nigeria in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figure stayed between 1075300 and 3645757 from 2013 to 2025.
New displacements from conflict were highest in 2014, and from disasters in 2012, in IDMC's records.

how.text: In 2025 IDMC counts 48814 fewer internally displaced people than UNHCR; the figures are never added together.
IDMC's new displacements count movements, not people: someone forced to move twice is counted twice.
